AppearanceConfig.description: The `launcher.appearance` section: the color scheme, the theme and how results look.

color_scheme.description: Light or dark: `system` follows the desktop, `light` and `dark` force one.

icons.description: Whether result rows show the application's icon. The preset supplies the default.

preset.description: The named layout preset supplying the defaults for this section.

theme.description: The palette: `system` follows the desktop, anything else names a curated theme.

tint.description: Whether the launcher background is translucent. Translucency, not blur.

ClockConfig.description: The `launcher.clock` section: the clock in the search's status bar.

format.description:
How the time is written: `hh:mm` (the default), `hh:mm:ss`, or `h:mm ap` for a 12-hour
clock.

interval.description: How often the clock is redrawn, in seconds.

installed.description:
Store extensions to install when they are missing: `raycast:<owner>/<name>`,
`vicinae:<owner>/<name>`, or the id one installs under. Compass installs them when it
starts and whenever this file changes, and never uninstalls one that is left out.

GlobalShortcutsConfig.description: The `global_shortcuts` section. The launcher's own key is `launcher.hotkey`.

inhibit_apps.description:
While one of these applications is focused, every global shortcut is
released so its keys reach the application: a virtual machine or a
remote desktop. Desktop file ids, e.g. `org.gnome.Boxes.desktop`.

InputServerConfig.description:
The `input_server` section: the keyboard helper behind snippet keyword
expansion (`compass-input-server`).

enabled.description:
Whether the helper runs. Off, snippet keywords do not expand; on, it
is started and restarted after a crash (five times, backing off).

appearance.description: The color scheme, the theme and how results look.

check_for_updates.description: Whether Compass checks its GitHub releases for a newer version.

clock.description: The clock the root search shows in its status bar.

close_on_focus_loss.description: Whether the launcher hides when it loses keyboard focus.

hotkey.description: The global chord that toggles the launcher, as `modifier+key`.

keybinding.description: The navigation chord scheme: `default` (the platform's, vim on Linux), `vim` or `emacs`.

max_results.description: How many results the launcher shows. `0` shows none.

pop_to_root_on_close.description: Whether hiding the launcher clears the search, so it always opens empty.

quick_launch.description: Whether Ctrl+1..9 launches the first through ninth result.

wrap_navigation.description: Whether moving past the last result selects the first, and the reverse.

RootEntrypointSettings.description: Per-entrypoint root search settings, keyed by entrypoint id under its provider.

alias.description: An extra search term the entrypoint answers to.

enabled.description: Whether the entrypoint appears in root search.

preferences.description: The command's own preferences, by name.

shortcut.description: A hotkey that runs the entrypoint directly, e.g. `ctrl+shift+c`.

RootProviderSettings.description: Per-provider root search settings, keyed by provider id (e.g. `applications`).

enabled.description: Whether the provider contributes to root search at all.

entrypoints.description: Settings for individual entrypoints of this provider.

TrayConfig.description:
The `tray` section: Compass's own icon in the desktop's tray
(`config::Tray`).

enabled.description:
Whether Compass shows its icon, with its menu (toggle the launcher,
settings, quit), in the tray. Applied at once when changed.

description:
A parsed `compass.json`.

[`Config::default`] is the fully-defaulted configuration and is what an empty file produces.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors. Ignored by the launcher.

fallbacks.description: Root items offered when a search has no match, as `provider:entrypoint` ids.

favicon_service.description: Where website icons are fetched from: `twenty`, `google` or `none`.

favorites.description: Root items pinned to the top of the empty search, as `provider:entrypoint` ids.

font.description:
The interface font: `font.normal.family` names a family, and `auto` or `system` follow
the desktop.

global_shortcuts.description: The global shortcuts, beyond the launcher hotkey.

input_server.description: The snippet keyword expander's keyboard helper.

providers.description: Root search settings per provider, keyed by provider id.

title: compass.json
